t: You're looking at the Royal Air Force Bomber Command Memorial, on the south side of Piccadilly in Green Park, facing Hyde Park Corner. It commemorates the 55,573 aircrew of Bomber Command who died in the Second World War, from Britain, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Poland, Czechoslovakia and other allied countries, as well as civilians of all nations killed during raids. The sculptor was Philip Jackson, a Scottish sculptor noted for his modern style, and the architect was Liam O'Connor.
